In a medium mixing bowl, combine mashed potatoes, 3/4 cup cheese, chili powder, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper. Spoon evenly into tortillas, and roll up. Place rolled tortillas side by side in a 8x8 inch baking pan. Spread enchilada sauce evenly over the top, and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Rhubarb Pie
ingredients: 2 c. rhubarb 1 Tbsp. butter 1 Tbsp. flour 1 1/4 c. sugar 3 eggs meringue
directions: Cut rhubarb in small pieces. Melt butter in saucepan. Add 1 cup sugar and rhubarb. Cook until tender; add egg yolks mixed with 1/4 cup of sugar and flour. Stir until mixture thickens. Pour in baked 9-inch pie shell and top with meringue.

title: Kit Kat's Frittata
ingredients: 3 large potatoes 6 eggs 2 garlic cloves 1 small onion (I use medium sized pickleing onions) 34-1 cup cheese, grated 1 -2 teaspoon dried herbs salt and pepper
directions: Note: I use non-stick teflon coated pans, I find that these produce the best results and I need little or no oil. Peel and cut potatoes into 1cm cubes and boil until al dente (I use the microwave for this). Finely dice garlic and onion and fry until translucent. Crack eggs and whisk lightly. Drain potatoes and fry, bake or grill until light golden brown (like you are cooking fries). Mix cheese and herbs in a large bowl and season. Add the potatoes, garlic and onion to the cheese and mix through. Add the whisked eggs to the mix and fold through. Heat a large non stick frying pan and pour in the mixture. (It may be a good idea to make 2 smaller frittate with this amount of ingredients, as you will then have room to scrape into sides as they cook and you will have more room to turn the frittata). Turn the heat down quite low, otherwise the base will get burnt. Scrape the sides of the frittata into the middles as they cook, the raw egg will move to the edges and you can repeat the action. When the frittata has cooked around the edges and there is only a section in the middle left uncooked, place under a hot grill until nice and golden. You may like to sprinkle cheese over the top while under the grill. The best way to remove the frittata from the pan is to slide it out onto a warm plate, this is why I insist on using non-stick pans Slice like you would a pizza and serve. Personally I like the frittata warm but not hot, but its also great cold. Variations: as I have said, it is so easy to vary this dish, here are some suggestions -- pumpkin and sweet potato (cooked in the same way as the potato, diced squash, zucchini, tomato, aubergine (eggplant), corn, mushrooms or broccoli. To turn it into a non-vego dish, add some diced ham/bacon (fry a little in the pan), shredded chicken or turkey or even some flaked fish. I have even used tofu on occasion. Yet another example of how versatile this dish is, change your seasonings; whisk in with the eggs some curry powder, cajun spices or some freshly chopped chilli. Enjoy, I believe alot of the joy of this dish comes from the cooking process itself.

title: Pao De Mel (Portuguese Honey Bread)
ingredients: cooking spray 3 cups flour 1 cup sugar 3 tablespoons unsweetened baking cocoa 1 teaspoon ground cloves or 1 teaspoon nutmeg 2 teaspoons baking powder 2 eggs 1 cup honey 1 cup milk 1 tablespoon pure irish butter, melted 5 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray one large loaf pan with the cooking spray and set aside. In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cocoa, cloves and baking powder. Add eggs, honey, milk and butter; combine well. Pour mixture into prepared pan. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let cool, then drizzle melted chocolate over the top.

title: Grits Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. grits 1 stick butter 1 pkg. garlic cheese or 8 oz. sharp Cheddar and 1 tsp. garlic powder or jalapeno cheese 2 eggs, beaten 3/4 c. milk
directions: Cook grits in 4 1/2 cups salted water. When done, add butter, cheese, eggs and milk. Stir until melted. Pour into greased casserole and sprinkle buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake 45 minutes or until center is done in a 350° oven.

title: Strawberry Crumble
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. plain flour 1/3 c. firmly packed brown sugar 3/4 c. soft margarine 1 c. finely chopped pecans 2 eggs whites 10 oz. strawberries (fresh or frozen) 1 c. sugar 2 tsp. fresh lemon juice 1 (10 oz.) c. whipped topping
directions: Beat 20 minutes at moderate speed. Add whipped topping and blend for 5 more minutes. Put half bread crumb crust on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon strawberry mixture on top. Sprinkle other half crumb crust on top. Freeze several hours or overnight. Cut in squares to serve.

title: Crockpot Pizza Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 medium onion, diced 1 red pepper, diced 2 (28 ounce) cans condensed tomato soup, undiluted 6 12 cups water 1 (28 ounce) jar spaghetti sauce 1 tablespoon italian seasoning 1 (4 ounce) cansliced black olives, drained 1 (4 ounce) can sliced mushrooms, drained 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese additional shredded cheddar cheese
directions: In a soup kettle or Dutch oven, cook beef with onions and red pepper over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. Add remaining ingredients to crockpot EXCEPT cheese. Stir to combine and cook on low for 6-8 hours. Before serving, add cheese. Stir until melted. Garnish with additional cheese if desired.

title: Savory Oven-Baked Pancake
ingredients: 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided 2 large eggs 1/4 cup low-fat milk 1/4 cup all-purpose flour salt fresh ground black pepper 1/4 cup diced onion 1/2 cup fresh green peas (or frozen and thawed) 1/4 cup diced red bell pepper 2 large white button mushrooms 1/4 cup dry white wine 1/2 cup grated jarlsberg cheese (or other low-fat Swiss-style cheese) 1 sprig fresh thyme, for garnish
directions: Preheat an oven to 400°; preheat a 5 or 6-inch round baking dish; melt 2 tablespoons of butter in the baking dish. Beat the eggs, milk, flour together until smooth; season with salt and pepper. When the butter is melted, pour the egg mixture into the baking dish and place in the oven; bake for 15 minuutes or until puffed and golden. Meanwhile, heat 1 teaspoon of the remaining butter in a skillet over medium heat. When hot, stir/saute the onion until translucent (about 5 minutes); add in the peas and bell pepper; cook for 2 more minutes; scrape mixture into a bowl and set aside. Slice the mushroom caps and stems thinly; heat the remaining 2 teaspoons butter in the skillet over med heat. When hot, stir/saute the mushrooms for 5 minutes or until browned. Add in the wine and cheese; return the onion mixture to the skillet; season to taste with salt and pepper; cook 2-3 minutes or until the mushrooms are cooked through. Remove pancake from oven, heap the mushroom mixture into the center; garnish with fresh thyme and serve. The pancake may deflate slightly as it cools.

title: Mustard Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 Chicken breast Mustard (hot English or other ) Butter For Pan Bread Crumbs 1 Quart of cream
directions: Preheat oven to 175 degrees celcius. Liberally coat a Baking dish with butter. Place chicken breasts in dish and brush with a liberal spread of mustard. spread breadcrums over chicken breasts and cover dish with Foil. Bake for approx 1 hour. Pour cream over just before serving. Use the cream and breadcrums mixture left in the dish as a sauce.

title: St. Patrick's Day Key Lime Cake Roll
ingredients: 1/2 cup powdered sugar 1 pkg. (2-layer size) white cake mix 1 pkg. (3 oz.) JELL-O Lime Flavor Gelatin 1 tub (8 oz.) COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed, divided 2 tsp. lime zest 1 pkg. (3.4 oz.) JELL-O Vanilla Flavor Instant Pudding 1 cup cold milk
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Spray 15x10x1-inch pan with cooking spray. Line with waxed paper; spray with additional cooking spray. Sprinkle clean kitchen towel with powdered sugar. Prepare cake batter as directed on package. Add dry gelatin mix; mix well. Pour into prepared pan; smooth top. Bake 26 to 28 min. or until top of cake springs back when touched in center. Immediately invert cake onto towel; remove pan. Carefully peel off paper. Starting at one short side, roll up cake and towel together. Cool completely on wire rack. Meanwhile, beat pudding mix and milk with whisk 2 min. Stir in 1 cup COOL WHIP. Refrigerate until cake is completely cooled. Unroll cake, leaving towel under cake. (Cake will crack.) Spread pudding mixture over cake. Reroll cake without towel; place on plate. Frost with remaining COOL WHIP; sprinkle with zest. Freeze 3 hours.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake
ingredients: 1 lemon angel food cake 1 pkg. lemon pudding mix (canned) 1 lemon yogurt spread 1 bowl Cool Whip
directions: Take 1 lemon angel food cake and slice into four layers. Mix lemon pudding and lemon yogurt; spread between layers. Frost with Cool Whip. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title: Apricot Custard Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups canned apricot nectar 6 tablespoons whipping cream 5 large egg yolks
directions: In a 1 1/2- to 2-quart pan over high heat, stir 1 1/4 cups canned apricot nectar and 6 tablespoons whipping cream until boiling, about 5 minutes. In a bowl, whisk 5 large egg yolks to blend. Whisk in about half of the hot apricot mixture. Put contents of bowl in pan. Stir over low heat until sauce thickly coats a metal spoon, 8 to 10 minutes. Set pan in a bowl of ice water and stir often until cool, about 8 minutes. If making ahead, chill airtight up to 2 days.

title: Roast Turkey Julia Child
ingredients: 1 (12- to 15-pound) turkey, neck and giblets removed and reserved for gravy 1 teaspoon plus 2 tablespoons minced fresh sage Salt and pepper Wooden skewers
directions: With turkey breast side up, cut through skin around leg quarter where it attaches to breast. Bend leg back to pop leg bone out of socket. Cut through joint to separate leg quarter. Repeat to remove second leg quarter. Working with 1 leg quarter at a time and with skin side down, use tip of knife to cut along sides of thighbone to expose bone, then slide knife under bone to free meat. Without severing skin, cut joint between thigh and leg and remove thighbone. Reserve thighbones for gravy. Rub interior of each thigh with 1/2 teaspoon sage, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Truss each thigh closed using wooden skewers and kitchen twine. Place leg quarters on large plate, cover, and refrigerate for 6 to 12 hours. Cut through ribs following vertical line of fat where breast meets back, from tapered end of breast to wing joint. Bend back away from breast to pop shoulder joint out of socket. Cut through joint between bones to separate back from breast. Reserve back for gravy. Trim excess fat from breast. Dissolve 3/4 cup salt in 6 quarts cold water in large container. Submerge breast in brine, cover, and refrig for 6 - 12 hours. Put oven temperature to 425 degrees. Remove breast from brine, pat dry with paper towels (leave leg quarters in refrigerator). Tuck wings behind back. Brush surface with 2 tsps oil. Place turkey breast skin side down in skillet and roast in oven for 30 minutes. Remove breast from oven and flip breast and place over 2/3 of stuffing. Arrange leg quarters over remaining stuffing and brush with remaining 1 teaspoon oil. Lightly season breast and leg quarters with salt. Tuck any large sections of exposed stuffing under bird so most of stuffing is covered by turkey. Transfer pan to oven and cook for 30 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees. Continue to roast until thickest part of breast is 165F and thickest part of thigh is 175F , 40-80 mins longer.Transfer breast and leg quarters to cutting board and let rest for 30 minutes.

title: Golden Banana Cake
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour 1/8 teaspoon baking powder pinch of baking soda 8 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 3/4 cup sugar 4 large eggs 1 extra-ripe medium banana, peeled and mashed
directions: Preheat the oven to 325F. Butter an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Dust the pan with flour, tapping out the excess. Sift together the flour, baking powder, and baking soda. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, mix together the butter, olive oil, and sugar at low speed. Increase the speed to medium and add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Mix in the mashed banana. Add the flour mixture and mix just until combined. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake the cake for 55 to 60 minutes, until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool the cake in the pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes. Unmold the cake and cool completely on the rack. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 3 days, 1 week refrigerated, or 2 months frozen.

title: Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine 4 ounces unsweetened chocolate 3 cups sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 (13 ounce) can evaporated milk
directions: Melt butter and chocolate in top of double boiler; stir in remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved and sauce is smooth. Serve warm or cold over ice cream.

title: Coconut Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 c. sugar 2 c. self-rising flour 1 1/2 c. coconut 5 eggs 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. coconut flavoring 1 c. oil
directions: Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Peanut Butter Worms
ingredients: 1 cup smooth peanut butter 1/2 cup honey 1 1/2 cups dry milk powder 1/2 cup powdered sugar Raisins and peanuts
directions: Place the peanut butter and honey in a food processor or mixer and combine well. Add the dry milk powder and the powdered sugar and mix again until smooth and well blended. Make into 1 long log and divide into 24 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thick worm and place 2 peanuts or raisins at the end to look like 2 eyes. Chill 30 minutes before serving. To serve, take a small flowerpot and fill it with balled up plastic wrap. Crumble up a leftover plain chocolate cup cake and spread that on top of the plastic wrap to make it look like a pot of soil. Using your finger poke a hole in the "soil", tuck the worm tails into the soil. Repeat this with 3 or 4 worms. Place the pot on a platter and surround the pot with the remainder of the worms

title: Key Lime Daiquiri Pie
ingredients: Pastry for single pie crust 2/3 C sugar 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 1/4 t salt 1/2 t lime zest 1/3 C lime juice 1/3 C water 3 slightly beaten egg yolks 6-8 drops green food coloring 1/4 C light rum 3 egg whites 1/3 C sugar
directions: Bake pie crust at 450 til golden, set aside and let cool. Combine 2/3 C sugar, gelatin, and salt. Stir in limejuice, water and yolks. Cook and stir over low heat til thickens slightly. Remove from heat, stir in zest, tint with food coloring. Cool slighly, stir in rum. Chill to consistency of corn syrup, stirring occasionally. Remove from refrigerator. Immediately beat egg whites til soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/3 C sugar, beating to stiff peaks. When gelatin is the consistency of unbeaten egg whites, fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Cihll til mixture mounds when spooned. Turn into baked pastry shell. Chill several hours or til set. cover, chill to serve.

title: Parmesan Baskets
ingredients: 8 ounces freshly grated Parmesan cheese, divided
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place about 2 teaspoons of Parmesan cheese onto a silicone sheet or baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and gently spread the cheese out into a circle about 2 inches in diameter. Spread more circles of cheese onto the baking sheet, keeping them at least 1 inch apart. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Remove from the oven, and let cool on the sheets until warm; while still warm, drape the wafers over a small bowl or other container. Let cool. Store at room temperature in an airtight container.

title: Caramel Corn with Cranberries
ingredients: 14 cups Unflavored Popped Popcorn (scant 2/3 Cups Unpopped Kernels) 1 cup Honey Roasted Peanuts 1/2 cups Dried Cranberries 1 cup Brown Sugar 1/4 cups Light Corn Syrup 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/2 cups Butter 1/4 teaspoons Baking Soda 1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract
directions: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees. Place the popped popcorn, peanuts, and cranberries in two large roasting pans. In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup, salt, and butter over medium heat. As the butter starts to melt, stir to mix completely. When the mixture begins to boil, stir constantly for five minutes. Remove from heat and mix in the baking soda and vanilla extract. Pour the caramel over the popcorn and stir a couple of times (not all of the popcorn will be coated). Bake for one hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Turn the popcorn out onto parchment paper, break apart, and allow to cool.

title: Buttermilk Cake
ingredients: 1 c. Crisco 2 c. sugar 3 c. flour 4 eggs 1 c. buttermilk 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Mix Crisco and sugar, then add eggs and blend well. Add flour, baking powder, soda and milk alternately. Add vanilla. Bake 1 hour in greased and floured tube pan at 350°. May be baked in 2 loaf pans for approximately 40 to 45 minutes.

title: Smoky Guacamole with Charred Shallots
ingredients: 3 medium shallots, peeled and sliced 1 teaspoon canola oil 3 large ripe Hass avocados, halved and pitted 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika 1/4 teaspoon ground chipotle 1/4 teaspoon Kosher or sea salt Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste 1 medium tomato, seeded and diced
directions: Heat a skillet over high heat. Add the oil and then add the shallots. Cook until soft and marginally charred, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. With the tip of a knife, cut each avocado half into a 1/2-inch grid, being careful not to cut through the skin. Scoop out the avocado into a bowl. Mash the avocado with a fork until it is nearly at your desired consistency. Stir in the charred shallots, lime juice, paprika, chipotle, salt, and pepper. Gently fold in the tomatoes. Serve immediately or else press a piece of plastic wrap flush into the top of the guacamole, refrigerate, and serve preferably within 24 hours.

title: Pork And Cilantro Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable or peanut oil 2 1/4 lb ground pork 2 tbsp finely grated fresh ginger 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 None large red pepper, deseeded, sliced 4 None baby bok choy, thickly shredded 2 tsp sesame oil 1/2 cup teriyaki marinade 1 lb fresh Hokkien noodles 1 cup fresh cilantro, leaves chopped
directions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Add ground pork and cook, stirring to break up lumps, for 7-8 mins, until browned. Add ginger and garlic. Stir-fry for 30 seconds, or until fragrant. Transfer to a large heatproof bowl. Wipe pan clean. Add remaining oil to pan and stir-fry pepper for 2 mins, until softened. Add bok choy and pork mixture. Toss to combine. Add sesame oil and marinade. Stir-fry for 2 mins, or until heated. Meanwhile, soak noodles in boiling water for 5 mins then stir to separate strands. Drain. Add to pork mixture and toss to combine. Sprinkle with fresh cilantro.

title: Tailgate Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb. ground beef 10 slices bacon, diced 1/2 onion, chopped 1/3 c. brown sugar 1/4 c. bottled barbecue sauce 1/4 c. catsup 2 Tbsp. mustard 2 Tbsp. molasses 1/2 tsp. chili powder 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 (16 oz.) can kidney beans 1 (16 oz.) can lima or butter beans 1 small can pinto beans 1 can pork and beans (not drained)
directions: In a skillet, cook beef and bacon until lightly browned. Pour off excess fat. Combine meats with all ingredients. Turn into casserole dish. Heat in 350° oven for 30 minutes. Serves 10.

title: Wasabi Salad Dressing
ingredients: Preparation: Mix soy sauce and vinegar in a bowl. Add sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Add sesame oil and wasabi paste and wisk well. Cool the dressing in the fridge until ready to serve. *Adjust the amount of wasabi and sugar, depending on your preference. This recipe's amount seasons four small salads. * 1 tsp soy sauce
directions: Preparation: Mix soy sauce and vinegar in a bowl. Add sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Add sesame oil and wasabi paste and wisk well. Cool the dressing in the fridge until ready to serve. *Adjust the amount of wasabi and sugar, depending on your preference. This recipe's amount seasons four small salads.

title: Simple Shortbread Cookie
ingredients: 2 cups All-purpose Flour Plus More For Flouring Work Surface 1/4 teaspoons Salt 1 stick Unsalted Butter, Room Temperature 1/2 cups Powdered Sugar 1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
directions: In a large bowl, sift the flour and salt. Cream butter and powdered sugar in the bowl of a standing mixer until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Reduce the speed to low and beat in the flour mixture until just incorporated. Gather dough and form it into a disk. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 30 minutes to chill. Preheat oven to 350 F. Line 2 baking trays with parchment paper. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into rounds or other shapes using a floured cookie cutter. Place on the prepared baking sheets and place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes. Remove the pans from the fridge and put them into the oven. Bake the cookies for 8 to 10 minutes, or until cookies are lightly browned. Remove from oven and let the cookies cool a few minutes on the baking sheet before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. Philadelphia cream cheese 7 oz. Kraft Marshmallow Creme
directions: Let cream cheese soften, then add Marshmallow Creme and beat until smooth with electric mixer. Makes approximately 25 servings.

title: Brown Rice and Apricot Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice 2 chopped scallions 2 chopped celery stalk Olive oil 6 chopped dried apricots
directions: Steam or cook brown rice for 45 minutes following package directions. Chop scallions and celery, saute in olive oil until tender. Add chopped apricots and scallion/celery mix to brown rice. Serve.

title: Hamburger Veggie Delight
ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. ground beef (chuck) 1 large head cabbage 2 large onions 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes 1 c. uncooked rice
directions: Boil cut up cabbage and onions in small amount of water. Boil until soft, adding tomatoes while cooking. Mix ground beef and rice into meatballs. Place in cooking pot. Cook on medium heat until meatballs are done, then simmer.

title: Steak Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground chuck 1/2 large onion, chopped 1 large can V-8 vegetable juice 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 (16 oz.) pkg. mixed vegetables (frozen) salt and pepper to taste
directions: Saute meat and onions. Combine with rest of ingredients. Simmer several hours on low. May also be simmered in crock-pot on low for several hours.

title: Molasses Cream Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 1 c. molasses 1 c. sour milk 1 tsp. ginger 1 Tbsp. vanilla 1 Tbsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 4 c. sifted flour
directions: Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate for 1 hour or more. Roll out on floured board and cut into favorite shapes or roll in hand to the size of a walnut. Then roll in white sugar and press down with glass. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes. May frost when cooled. Makes 8 dozen soft cookies.

title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: cabbage Pepperidge Farm herb dressing 1 can cream of mushroom soup Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Cut, core out and wedge cabbage thin. Boil in salted water for 10 minutes. Layer in casserole dish the cabbage, dressing, soup and cheese. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender at 350°.

title: Hot Cranberry Tea
ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1 1/2 cinnamon sticks 1 cup orange juice 2 cups cranberry juice 2 teaspoons lemon juice 6 cups water
directions: In a large pan, cook water, sugar, and cinnamon sticks over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes and serve hot. Can be refrigerated, but remove cinnamon sticks first.

title: Meat Balls
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 tsp. salt 1 can tomato soup 1/2 c. water 1/3 c. uncooked rice 1/4 c. water dash of pepper 1/2 tsp. chili powder
directions: Combine meat, rice, onion, 1/4 cup water, salt and pepper. Shape into 15 (1-inch) balls. Blend soup and chili powder. Stir in 1/2 cup water and bring to a boil. Add meat balls. Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour.

title: Pesto-Stuffed Cremini Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tsp. olive oil 24 medium-sized cremini mushrooms, stems removed and chopped 1 7-oz. tube ground soy sausage 1/2 cup breadcrumbs 1/2 cup prepared pesto
directions: Preheat oven to 350F (unless making ahead). Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add mushroom stems, and cook 5 minutes, stirring often. Break sausage into small pieces, add to skillet and brown 10 minutes, stirring often. Transfer mixture to food processor, and coarsely chop. Add breadcrumbs and pesto, and pulse until just combined. Season with salt and pepper. Stuff into mushrooms, slightly mounding tops. Arrange mushrooms in 9x9-inch ungreased baking dish. (If making ahead, cover with foil, and refrigerate.) Add 1/2 cup water to dish, tightly cover with foil and bake 10 minutes. Remove foil, and bake 10 minutes more, or until browned. Serve hot.

title: Mussels With Saffron Cream
ingredients: 1 large onion, halved lengthwise Rounded 1/4 teaspoon crumbled saffron threads 3/4 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 cup dry white wine 1 cup heavy cream 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 4 lb cultivated mussels, rinsed well 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley Accompaniment: prepared garlic bread an adjustable-blade slicer
directions: Cut onion halves crosswise into less than 1/16-inch-thick slices with slicer. Cook onion with saffron and 1/2 teaspoon salt in oil in a wide 6- to 8-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. Add wine and bring to a boil, then stir in cream, pepper, remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt, and mussels. Cook, covered, checking after 6 minutes and transferring opened mussels to soup bowls with a slotted spoon. (Discard any that remain unopened after 8 minutes.) Stir parsley into broth and pour over mussels.

title: Beef Vegetable Borsch
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. butter 1 medium onion, chopped 2 carrots, sliced 1/2 head cabbage, shredded 1 Tbsp. minced parsley 1 c. stewed tomatoes 2 cans beef broth 1 Tbsp. vinegar 1 can beets (undrained) 1 or 2 c. diced cooked beef salt and pepper 1 tsp. or more sugar sour cream
directions: In large kettle, melt butter. Saute vegetables for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes, broth, vinegar, beets and meat; bring to boil. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes. Season to taste. Top with sour cream.

title: Swedish Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 c. raisins 1/2 c. walnuts 1 orange rind 2 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1/4 lb. butter 1 c. sugar 2 eggs
directions: Grind raisins, walnuts and orange rind. Cream the butter and sugar. Add the beaten eggs. Fold in dry ingredients, alternating with sour milk. Add fruit, nuts and flavoring. Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 350°. Pour over hot cake in pan 1/2 cup sugar and juice of 1 orange.

title: Fresh Mozzarella Pasta Toss
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. olive oil 1 small onion, chopped King Sooper's 1 lb For $0.99 thru 02/09 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 zucchini, quartered, sliced 3 cups CLASSICO FAMILY FAVORITES Traditional Pasta Sauce 1 cup POLLY-O Original Ricotta Cheese 16 POLLY-O Fresh Mozzarella, Ciliegine balls, drained 1/2 lb. penne pasta, cooked, drained 1/4 lb. prosciutto, chopped 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
directions: Heat oil in large saucepan on medium-high heat. Add onions and garlic; cook and stir 2 min. or until crisp-tender. Add zucchini; cook and stir 5 min. or until zucchini is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook 5 min. or until heated through.

title: Crispy Chocolate Ice Cream Mud Pie
ingredients: 12 cup Hershey's syrup or 12 cup hershey's whoppers chocolate malt syrup 13 cup hershey's special dark chocolate chips or 13 cup Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips 2 cups crisp rice cereal 4 cups vanilla ice cream, divided 4 cups chocolate ice cream, divided additional Hershey's syrup or hershey's whoppers chocolate malt syrup
directions: 1. Butter 9-inch pie plate. 2. Place 1/2 cup chocolate syrup and chocolate chips in medium microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at MEDIUM (50%) 45 seconds or until hot; stir until smooth. Reserve 1/4 cup chocolate syrup mixture; set aside. Add cereal to remaining chocolate mixture, stirring until well coated; cool slightly. 3. Press cereal mixture, using back of spoon, evenly on bottom and up sides of prepared pie plate to form crust. Place in freezer 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is firm. Spread half of vanilla ice cream into crust; spoon reserved 1/4 cup chocolate syrup mixture over layer. Spread half of chocolate ice cream over sauce. 4. Top with alternating scoops of vanilla and chocolate ice cream. Cover; return to freezer until serving time. Drizzle with additional syrup just before serving. 8 servings.

title: Sunny Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 5 c. sliced potatoes 2 Tbsp. flour 1 tsp. salt dash of pepper 1/2 lb. Velveeta pasteurized process cheese spread, cubed 3/4 c. milk 1/4 c. chopped green pepper 1/4 c. chopped onion 2 Tbsp. pimiento strips
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Coat potatoes with combined flour and seasonings. Place in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Heat Velveeta and milk over low heat. Add green pepper, onion and pimiento. Pour Velveeta sauce over potatoes. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, or until potatoes are done. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: Yogurt Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 1 tablespoon lime juice, freshly squeezed 14 cup natural yoghurt 14 teaspoon dried oregano (or another dried herb, or substitute 1 tsp chopped fresh herbs) 12 teaspoon fructose
directions: Whisk everything together. Pour over your salad of choice!

title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
ingredients: 1 c. butter or oleo 2 c. sugar 6 eggs 12 oz. box vanilla wafers, crushed, or 3 c. 1/2 c. milk 2 cans Angel Flake coconut 1 to 3 c. pecans, chopped
directions: Cream butter or oleo and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Alternating, add vanilla wafer crumbs and milk, a little at a time, ending with the wafers. Add coconut and pecans and beat well. Pour into greased and floured loaf or tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake seems to be done after testing with knife blade in center of cake. Let cool in the pan.

title: Shrimp kabobs, Chicken kabobs, and Steak kabobs!!!!!
ingredients: 1 onion, chopped 1 green yellow red and orange pepper, chopped 2 lb chicken breasts 2 lb steak 2 lb shrimp
directions: Chop everything into chunk.

title: Party Reubens(Appetizer)
ingredients: 1/4 c. Thousand Island dressing 2 tsp. Dijon mustard 1 tsp. prepared horseradish 2 Tbsp. margarine, softened 24 slices party size rye bread 12 thin slices corned beef, cut in half 1/2 c. sauerkraut, drained 6 (1 oz.) slices Swiss cheese, quartered
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients; set aside. Spread 1/4 teaspoon butter on top of each bread slice. Place a half slice of corned beef on each slice, folding beef to fit. Top each with 1/2 teaspoon sauce mixture, 1 teaspoon sauerkraut and a piece of cheese. Place bread slices on baking sheet; broil 8 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes, or until cheese melts. Yields 2 dozen.

title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. garlic salt 1/8 tsp. oregano 1 tsp. parsley flakes 1 Tbsp. minced onion 1 large can tomato sauce 1/2 lb. hamburger 1 pkg. (8) crescent rolls sliced American cheese
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients and simmer 5 minutes. Cook the hamburger until brown. Drain off fat. Add 3/4 cup of the tomato sauce to the meat. Flatten out crescent rolls and press two together to form square (4 squares). Place approximately 1/4 hamburger mixture on each rectangle. Top with 1/2 slice American cheese. Bring up corners of dough to meet and pinch together to seal all openings. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Add 1/3 cup water and any remaining hamburger mixture to tomato sauce and simmer gently while pies are baking. Sauce can be spooned over pies at the table.

title: Potato-Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 potatoes, sliced thinly 1 to 2 stalks celery, chopped 1/2 large onion, chopped 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1/4 c. margarine 2 1/2 Tbsp. flour 1 1/8 tsp. A. 1. sauce 1/2 tsp. mustard powder 1 1/2 c. milk 6 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes pinch of parsley or dill weed
directions: Cook vegetables in boiling water until soft. Set aside.

title: Chicken Or Fish Batter Recipe
ingredients: 1 pkg. biscuit mix 1 egg 1/2 teaspoon vinegar 1/2 c. cream 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper
directions: Mix all ingredients together till thin and smooth. Then, dip chicken or possibly fish, drop in deep fryer till done.

title: The Vesper
ingredients: 3 parts Gordons gin (007s preference) 1 part vodka (any Russian will do) 1/2 part Lillet Blanc 1 generous strip of lemon peel
directions: Pour the gin, vodka and Lillet into an ice-filled mixing glass and shake. Strain into a chilled coupe. Twist the outsize peel over the drink, then drop it in.

title: Dahl Soup - Fijian Indian Version
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split peas 6 cups water 1 teaspoon turmeric 1 teaspoon salt (to taste) 1/2 onion, finely chopped 2 garlic cloves 1 -2 teaspoon mustard seeds, black if available 1 teaspoon chili powder (to taste) 1 tablespoon oil or 1 tablespoon ghee coriander, fresh chopped
directions: Place yellow split peas, water, turmeric and salt into largish saucepan and bring to boil. Turn down heat once boiling and simmer until peas are tender. About 45 - 60 minutes. Meanwhile, heat ghee or oil and gently fry onion and garlic until slightly brown. Add mustard seeds and chilli powder and fry a further 2 - 3 minutes. Add onion mixture to soup. Garnish with chopped coriander and serve with roti bread or poppadoms. Optional: A skinned, finely chopped tomato can also be added to soup when serving. Enjoy!

title: Picadillo Puerto Viallrta(Mexican Hash)
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. olive oil 2 lb. chopped lean beef 2 onions, finely chopped 1 clove garlic, chopped 2 apples, peeled, cored and chopped 1 lb. (about 3 medium) tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped 3 canned jalapeno chilies, seeded and sliced 1/2 c. raisins 1/4 c. pimento stuffed olives, cut in half 1/8 tsp. cinnamon 1/8 tsp. cloves salt freshly ground pepper 1/4 c. slivered almonds
directions: Heat the oil, in a large, heavy skillet, and brown the meat, then add the onions and garlic. When brown, add all the other ingredients, except the almonds, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Simmer gently, uncovered, until cooked or about 20 minutes.

title: Raspberry Cordial Cupcakes
ingredients: You Favorite Cupcake Recipe Or Box Mix 1 package (3 Oz. Package) Raspberry Gelatin 1/2 containers (8 Oz. Container) Whipped Topping 1 cup Raspberries (Fresh Or Frozen)
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water as instructed on the box. Chill for about 1 hour until slightly set. Fold in whipped topping and raspberries. Chill until set. Spoon the mousse over your favorite cupcakes. Top with extra whipped cream and drizzled chocolate. More directions on the related blog post link.

title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes or 4 medium yams, about 2 lbs 1/4 cup packed brown sugar 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup orange juice 1/2 cup crushed pineapple TOPPING 1 tablespoon packed brown sugar 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter 1 teaspoon water 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows 1/4 cup chopped pecans
directions: Wash potatoes, peel & cut into 1/2 inch slices. Cook in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain well, place into a 2 quart casserole dish & mash. Add brown sugar, margarine & salt; continue mashing until no lumps remain. Mix in orange juice & pineapple & set aside. Place first 5 topping ingredients into a medium sized pot, over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the margarine is melted. Add the marshmallows & toss to coat. Top the sweet potatoes with the marshmallow mixture & sprinkle with the pecans. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 350F oven until the potatoes are heated through & the marshmallows are melted, 30- 45 minutes. I sometimes leave it longer to make the topping almost become like candy!

title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cooked and chopped 1 medium apple, chopped 1/2 cup celery, chopped 1/2 cup sweet pickles, chopped 1/2 cup pecans, chopped 2 tsp. sugar Salt to taste Mayonnaise
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.

title: Shrimp and Tarragon Mustard Dip
ingredients: 2 tsp. dijon mustard 1-1/2 tsp. white wine vinegar 2 tsp. dried tarragon, crushed 3/4 cup baby shrimp 1 tsp. lemon juice 2 tsp. fresh tarragon, chopped 1 cup mayonnaise 1/2 cup sour cream
directions: Mix the mustard, lemon juice, vinegar, and tarragon. Blend in the mayonnaise. Add the shrimp, then the sour cream. Blend well. Cover and chill.

title: Peach Bread Pudding
ingredients: 9 Rhodes Warm-N-Serv Soft White Dinner Rolls, baked and day old 3 eggs 1 1/2 cups milk 1/3 cup sugar 1 teaspoon almond extract 21 ounce can Peach Pie Filling
directions: Cut rolls into 1/2 inch cubes. Place cubes in a sprayed 8-inch square baking pan. In a bowl, combine eggs, milk, sugar, almond extract and 1 cup peach pie filling. Mix well. Pour over roll cubes. Press down with a spoon to make sure all of the roll cubes are covered with egg mixture. If time permits, let soak for 30 minutes. Bake at 350°F 30-40 minutes. Heat remaining pie filling and serve over warm pudding.

title: Oatmeal Pudding Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 c. butter 1/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. brown sugar, packed 1 pkg. vanilla pudding 2 eggs 3 1/2 c. quick cook oats
directions: Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter, sugar and pudding in mixing bowl and beat until smooth. Beat in eggs. Add flour, then oats. Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 6 to 10 minutes.

title: Peppermint Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 lb. peppermint stick candy 1/2 c. light cream 1 Tbsp. gelatin 2 Tbsp. cold water 1 1/2 c. heavy cream 1/2 lb. chocolate sandwich cookies
directions: Crush candy and put into saucepan. Add light cream and heat until candy is dissolved. Dissolve gelatin in water and add to candy mixture. Chill until partly set. Fold in whipped cream. Crush cookies and place a layer in bottom of casserole, then layer of peppermint mixture. Repeat until all is used. Chill for 12 hours.

title: Fresh Strawberry Cobbler
ingredients: 4 c. strawberries, washed and hulled (1 qt.) 2/3 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. lemon juice 2 Tbsp. margarine 1 1/2 c. buttermilk biscuit mix 3 Tbsp. melted margarine 1 egg, slightly beaten 1/2 c. milk whipped cream or ice cream
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Spray with nonstick vegetable shortening a 6 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Toss berries lightly with sugar and lemon juice and place in baking dish. In a bowl, combine biscuit mix, melted margarine, eggs and milk. Lightly mix with a fork and spoon-drop dough over berries. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until crust is golden brown. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Time Bomb
ingredients: 2 parts white rum 1 part Kahlua 2 parts cola ice (optional)
directions: Place rum and Kahlua in a cocktail glass, add ice if desired. Top with cola and serve.

title: Pink (Beetroot) Pancakes
ingredients: 1 pinch salt 1 Egg 1 cup plain white or wholewheat flour 2 tsp (heaped) baking powder 3/4 cup Apple Juice 1/2 cup finely grated raw (or cooked) beetroot 1/2 tsp mixed spice (or nutmeg+cinnamon)
directions: Whisk the egg until frothy. Add flour, baking powder and salt. Pour in the apple juice. Give it all a good whisk. Fold in the beetroot and spice. Warm a frying pan over high heat. Brush on a bit of olive oil. Drop in dessert spoonfuls of the pancake batter into the centre of the pan. Grab a spatula. As soon as the pancake starts to bubble up in the centre, flip it over and cook for 2 minutes or so, until cooked through. Don't be tempted to press the pancake down in the pan as it cooks as this will press out all the lovely air bubbles that make it nice and fluffy. When all your pancakes are cooked, add a dot of butter on the top of each, and then serve with a drizzle of honey.

title: Caramel Apple Pudding
ingredients: 5 large granny smith apples, peeled, cored, sliced 1cm thick 250 g flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 150 g caster sugar 200 ml milk 150 g unsalted butter, melted 2 eggs, beaten 200 g brown sugar 12 cup golden syrup
directions: Preheat the oven to 180C Lightly butter a 2.5-litre baking dish. Peel, core and slice apples into 1cm rounds. Place apples in the prepared dish. Sift flour and baking powder into the bowl of an electric mixer, add caster sugar, milk, butter and egg, then beat until pale. Spread mixture over the apples. Place muscovado or brown sugar, golden syrup and 300ml water in a saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves, then bring to the boil without stirring. Pour over the pudding batter, then bake for 30-35 minutes or until the top is golden. Serve with cream.

title: Chilled Tomato-Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 4 cups roasted tomatoes 1 large cucumber, peeled seeded and diced 2 scallions, sliced 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro 2 garlic cloves 1/2 teaspoon Tabasco sauce 1 pinch coarse salt 1 pinch ground black pepper 2 cups tomato juice, approximately
directions: Place tomatoes and cucumber in food processor with scallion, cilantro, garlic, tabasco, salt, pepper, and enough tomato juice to almost cover. Process about 1 minute until still slightly coarse. Adjust seasoning. Serve very cold. Garnish with yogurt and diced cucumber.

title: Beefsteak Florentine in Olive Oil and Garlic Marinade with Nancy's Mushroom Vinaigrette
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 2 teaspoons kosher or other coarse salt 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 (2 to 2 1/2-inch) thick (or thicker) porterhouse steak (2 to 3 pounds) Lemon wedges for garnish 1/2 -ounce dried porcini, morel, or shiitake mushrooms 1 cup boiling water 1/4 cup dry vermouth or dry sherry 2 cups chicken stock or veal stock, or canned chicken broth 2 tablespoons olive oil, plus 1/4 to 1/2 cup olive oil 3/4 pound fresh medium-sized mushrooms, sliced 1 tablespoon minced shallots or garlic 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar or more to taste 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar Salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: Make the marinade: mix together the oil, salt, pepper, and the garlic in a small bowl. Put the steak in shallow bowl or a dish and rub the mixture all over the meat. Marinate at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours or, better still, covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. Turn the meat from time to time to coat both sides evenly. To prepare: remove the steak from the refrigerator at least an hour before cooking. When you are ready to grill, prepare a charcoal fire so that you have areas of higher and lower heat. Drain off any excess oil from the steak. Sear the steak over the high-heat area of the grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove the grill rack and sprinkle 2 cups soaked hickory or oak chips on the low-heat part of the fire. Replace the grill and place the steak over the low-heat area. Cover the grill, but turn the steak frequently; this should take 10 to 20 minutes more, depending on the thickness of the steak and the heat of the fire. Check the interior of the meat with an instant-read thermometer, and remove the steaks at 5 to 7 degrees below the desired degree of doneness. Let the steak rest, covered loosely with foil, for 10 minutes or so before carving. To carve, cut the loin meat and the fillet meat away from the bone. Cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices. Arrange meat on a platter with the lemon wedges. Serve with vinaigrette (recipe below). Place the dried mushrooms in a glass measuring cup or bowl. Add enough boiling water to cover and soak for at least 30 minutes. Remove the soaked mushrooms with a slotted spoon. Chop them and set them aside. Carefully pour the soaking liquid into a saucepan, leaving the last bit of liquid and any grit behind. Add the vermouth or sherry and the chicken or veal stock and bring to a boil. Continue to boil until the flavors are concentrated and the sauce is reduced to about 1/2 cup. Set aside while you cook the mushrooms. Heat the 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the fresh mushrooms and shallots or garlic and cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes. Put in the reserved dried mushrooms and continue to cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. If any liquid accumulates in the skillet, pour it into the saucepan with the reduced sauce. Boil the sauce briefly, if you wish, to intensify the flavors further. Pour the reduced sauce over the mushrooms and add both vinegars. Using a whisk, beat in enough of the remaining oil to form a slightly thick, homogenous vinaigrette. Taste for salt and pepper and red wine vinegar and serve with steak

title: Potato And Broccoli Frittata
ingredients: 4 c. frozen or fresh chopped broccoli 2 potatoes, sliced 4 Tbsp. olive oil or cooking oil 1/2 c. finely chopped red or green bell pepper 2 small cloves garlic 12 eggs 1 c. grated Parmesan cheese (fresh) 1/2 c. water 1 tsp. dried basil, crushed 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 2 Tbsp. grated fresh Parmesan
directions: In large skillet, cook potato slices, uncovered, in hot oil for 5 minutes or until just tender, turning occasionally. Add onion, pepper and garlic. Cook until onion is tender. Add thawed broccoli; reduce heat and cook, covered, for 5 minutes more. Beat together eggs, cheese, water, basil, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables in skillet. Cook over medium-low heat for 5 to 6 minutes. As eggs set, run a spatula around the edge of the skillet, lifting egg mixture to allow uncooked portion to flow underneath. Continue cooking and lifting edge until mixture is almost set. (The surface will be moist.) Remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 3 to 4 minutes or until top is set. Sprinkle with cheese. Cut into wedges; serve from the skillet.

title: Forget-Me-Not Cones
ingredients: 1 pkg. (3.9 oz.) JELL-O Chocolate Flavor Instant Pudding 1 cup cold milk 2 cups thawed COOL WHIP Whipped Topping 10 Oreo Cookies, crushed, divided 1 pkg. (1-3/4 oz.) ice cream cones 12 Marshmallow Flowers (See Tip.)
directions: Beat pudding mix and milk in large bowl with whisk 2 min. Let stand 5 min. Stir in COOL WHIP and 3/4 cup cookie crumbs. Spoon into ice cream cups; sprinkle with remaining cookie crumbs to resemble dirt in flower pots. Flatten tops slightly with back of spoon. Top with Marshmallow Flowers.

title: Chocolate and Walnut Bread Panini
ingredients: 1 round loaf of walnut bread 1 pound bitter chocolate Sweet butter, to coat the bread
directions: Slice the walnut bread thin into 8 slices. Heat a large nonstick skillet or a griddle over moderate heat. Butter 1 side of each bread slice, then put 4 slices, buttered side down, on a work surface. Cut chocolate into chunks, thin enough to fit in a sandwich. Place on the bread, cover with another slice of walnut bread and butter the side facing up. Grill on both sides, about 3 to 5 minutes each. Serve warm.

title: Prawns With Wine And Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb. prawns 1 cube butter 1 c. white wine 1 tsp. minced garlic 1 bunch green onions, sliced 1 inch 1 tsp. flour 2 c. cooked rice
directions: Melt butter over medium heat; turn to low heat. Add garlic, green onions and prawns. Saute until prawns turn pink. Add wine; bring to simmer. Thicken with flour slightly. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

title: Havreflarn (Swedish Lace Wafers)
ingredients: 1/2 c. flour 1/4 tsp. baking powder 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. oats 2 tsp. heavy cream 2 tsp. light corn syrup 1/3 c. melted oleo 1 tsp. vanilla
directions: Sift together in a bowl the flour, baking powder and sugar. Add oats, heavy cream, corn syrup, oleo and vanilla; mix well. Drop on ungreased sheet 4 inches apart using 1/4 teaspoon as measure. Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove carefully to waxed paper to cool. Makes approximately 6 dozen 2-inch wafers.

title: Curried Squash With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tbsp peanut oil 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp ground cumin 1 tsp ground caraway 1 tsp ground nutmeg 1 tsp mild curry powder 1/2 tsp ground turmeric 1 None medium Spanish onion, sliced thinly 1 None medium carrot, sliced thinly 10.5 oz yellow squash, quartered 1 None medium green pepper, sliced thinly 7 oz button mushrooms, halved 1 tsp cornstarch 3/4 cups coconut cream 1 tbsp fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped
directions: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat. Stir-fry garlic and spices until fragrant. Add onion and carrot. Stir-fry until onion is soft. Add squash, pepper and mushrooms. Stir-fry until tender. Mix together cornstarch and coconut cream then stir until mixture boils and thickens slightly. Serve sprinkled with cilantro.

title: Southwestern Marinade for Grilling
ingredients: 1 limes, zest of or 1 lime, juice of 2 tablespoons canola oil 14 cup honey 14 cup water hot sauce 14 cup chopped fresh cilantro 1 green onion, chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 12 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1 12 teaspoons chili powder 1 teaspoon cumin 12 teaspoon cocoa powder 1 pinch salt
directions: combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir until honey is dissolved. pour into a resealable bag and add meat, making sure each piece is thoroughly coated. refridgerate for at least 6 hours; overnight is best.

title: Starfruit Sangria Recipe
ingredients: 12 ounces sauvignon blanc or dry riesling, chilled 6 ounces London dry gin, such as Tanqueray 8 ounces freshly squeezed lemon juice 6 ounces simple syrup 10 dashes orange bitters 1 starfruit ice 3 ounces chilled club soda or ginger beer
directions: In a large pitcher, stir wine, gin, lemon juice, simple syrup, and orange bitters together. Add 1 cup of ice and stir well. Slice starfruit into 1/4-inch thick slices. Fill serving glasses with ice and line sides with starfruit slices. Add club soda or ginger beer to wine mixture, stir gently to blend, and pour into serving glasses.

title: Pesto Zucchini "Spaghetti"
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini julienned thinly, mandoline slicers are great for this 1 pinch salt 6 slices bacon uncooked 1/2 cup green onions sliced into 1-inch pieces 2 cups broccoli florets 3 tablespoons basil pesto prepared Parmesan cheese Fresh, for garnish
directions: Place zucchini strips in a colander over a bowl or in the sink. Sprinkle zucchini with salt and toss to combine. Let the zucchini sit for 15 minutes while the salt extracts the moisture. Drain excess water, squeezing zucchini, if necessary. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, turning frequently. Remove bacon to a stack of paper towels to drain. Crumble bacon. Remove all but 2 T of bacon drippings from the pan. Return the pan to medium heat. Add the green onions and broccoli, stirring frequently for about 3-5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add zucchini and 2 T of pesto, tossing to combine all ingredients. Taste and add more pesto, if needed. The mixture only needs to warm up, so 2-3 minutes of cooking ought to do it. Serve with bacon crumbles and freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Grilled Chicken Satays With Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 teaspoons ginger, chopped 2 teaspoons garlic, chopped 1 teaspoon ground coriander 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, trimmed and cut into thin strips (about 3 x 1/4 inch each) peanut sauce (recipe posted separately) chopped peanuts, garnish cilantro, garnish
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the soy, oil, fish sauce, ginger, garlic, coriander, and pepper flakes. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Let marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours, turning occasionally. Preheat the grill to medium high (or preheat the broiler). Remove the chicken from the marinade and thread 1 strip of chicken down the middle of each skewer. In batches, cook the satays on the grill (or on a broiler pan under the broiler) until the chicken is cooked through and the meat is browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side, watching carefully and turning so the meat does not burn. To serve, arrange the skewers on a platter and lightly drizzle with the peanut sauce and chopped peanuts. Serve additional sauce in a bowl on the side for dipping. Garnish with cilantro sprigs and serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Peanut Butter Balls
ingredients: 1 c. chunky peanut butter 1 c. plus 3 Tbsp. powdered sugar 3 Tbsp. heavy whipping cream 1/2 c. miniature semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Place peanut butter in a medium glass bowl. Microwave on High for 30 to 40 seconds to soften. Stir in 1 cup powdered sugar; add the cream until well blended. Add chocolate chips and stir until well mixed. Roll the peanut butter cream into 1-inch balls. Sift remaining powdered sugar over the balls and roll them in sifted powdered sugar. Store, covered, in the refrigerator. Yield: 28 Peanut Butter Balls.

title: Raisin, Cinnamon, Pecan Quick Bread
ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat flour 3/4 cup pastry flour 1/4 cup sugar 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 cup unprocessed wheat bran 1/4 cup canola oil 1 1/2 cups seedless raisins 1 1/2 cups hot water 2 egg whites 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/4 cup chopped pecans cooking spray
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.Stir together whole-wheat flour, pastry flour, sugar, baking soda and baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Using a separate bowl, combine wheat bran, canola oil, raisins and hot water. Add egg whites and vanilla. Beat well. Add nuts and dry ingredients. Stir until all ingredients are moist. Spray bread pan (9 X 5 X 3) with cooking spray and spread batter in pan. Bake 45-55 minutes. Let cool before slicing.

title: Peanut Butter Surprise Balls Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 c. peanut butter 1 tbsp. honey 1/3 c. nonfat dry lowfat milk pwdr 2 tbsp. sesame seed 2 tbsp. toasted wheat germ 1/2 c. cornflakes Raisins, peanuts, semi-sweet chocolate pcs or possibly candy-coated lowfat milk chocolate pcs
directions: 1. To make the dough, put peanut butter and honey in the bowl. Stir to mix well. 2. Add in dry lowfat milk pwdr, sesame seed and wheat germ. Stir till well mixed. 3. Put cornflakes in a plastic bag. Seal bag shut. Crush cornflakes. Sprinkle crushed cornflakes over a piece of wax paper. 4. Use a small spoon to scoop spoonfuls of the dough. Shape the dough around a raisin, peanut, chocolate piece or possibly candy. Roll in cornflakes. 5. Put balls in a tightly covered container. Place in the refrigerator. Makes approximately 25 balls.

title: Marinated Broccoli And Dip
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli 1/4 c. cider vinegar 3/4 c. salad oil 2 Tbsp. fresh dill 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1 1/2 tsp. sugar
directions: Mix in large Ziploc or sealed container with fresh, cut up broccoli. Marinate several hours or overnight.

title: Soft Pretzels
ingredients: 1 pkg. active dry yeast 1 1/2 c. warm water 1 Tbsp. sugar 1 tsp. salt 3 1/2 to 4 c. flour 1 egg, beaten pinch of salt
directions: Dissolve yeast, sugar and salt in water. Blend in flour. Place on floured board and knead for 10 minutes. Pinch off small strips. Roll into 12 ropes. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Brush with beaten egg, then sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Turkey Sausage and Bean Stew (Low Fat)
ingredients: 12 ounces turkey sausage, links 2 (14 -16 ounce) canscooked beans, drained and rinsed 2 cups diced tomatoes 2 cups carrots, sliced 1 medium onion, chopped 1 cup celery, sliced 1 potato, with skin diced 12 cup fresh parsley, chopped 1 cup chicken stock 2 bay leaves 2 teaspoons pepper 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper 2 garlic cloves, minced
directions: Boil the sausage 15 minutes, piercing the skin in several places to allow the fat to drain from the links. Remove from the pan and cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Set aside. Mix the beans, tomatoes, carrots, onion, celery, potato, parsley, and chicken stock in a large pot and bring to a boil. Add the bay leaves, pepper, cayenne pepper, garlic, and sausage. Salt to taste and stir thoroughly. Add water if desired. Heat to boiling, turn to low, and simmer one hour or til carrots are tender.

title: Grandma'S Oyster Snack
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) pkg. oyster crackers 2 pkg. Hidden Valley dressing mix 1/2 tsp. garlic salt 1 tsp. dill weed 1 tsp. lemon pepper 1 c. corn oil
directions: Mix oil and all the seasonings together and heat to boiling. Pour over crackers and toss well. Store in a covered plastic container.

title: Vegetable Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 c. grated carrots 1/2 c. minced green peppers 1/2 c. chopped cucumbers 1/4 c. minced onions 1/4 c. chopped celery 1/4 tsp salt 2 8 oz cream cheese 2 tbsp mayonnaise 3 tbsp ranch dressing mix
directions: Combine vegetables well. Beat remaining ingredients until fluffy. Fold in vegetables allow to chill several hours.

title: Black Forest Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. devil's food cake mix 1 can cherry pie filling 1 (8 oz.) container Cool Whip 1 tsp. vanilla flavoring 1 tsp. grated orange rind
directions: You may use other pie mix instead of cherry.

title: Screwdriver Chicken
ingredients: flour salt and pepper paprika 6 chicken breasts, boneless, skinless 1/4 cup canola oil 2 garlic cloves, chopped 3 tablespoons butter 3/4 cup orange juice 3/4 cup vodka 1 dash cayenne pepper parsley
directions: In a plastic bag, combine flour with salt, pepper, and enough paprika to slightly make the flour pink. Add the chicken breast to the flour and toss to coat completely. put oil, butter, and garlic in a 10 inch skillet and heat until hot. add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 3 to 5 minutes. remove the chicken to a platter with paper towel to drain oil. reduce the heat and add orange juice, vodka, parsley, and cayenne to the pan and stir to scrape up the pan drippings - sprinkle in some flour to thicken up the sauce if you would like. immediately add the chicken, return heat to high, and cook for 1 more minute.

title: Sopaipillas
ingredients: 2 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 2 Tbsp. shortening 3/4 c. cold water oil (for frying)
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mealy. Add water, a tablespoon at a time, and toss with a fork to blend. Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. Roll out as thin as possible. Cut into 2 or 3-inch squares and fry in hot oil, 370°, until puffed and browned. Makes 20 to 30, depending on size. Serve warm with cinnamon sugar or syrup, if desired.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Pops
ingredients: 1/2 pinch half and half 3/4 cup sugar Pinch salt 1 egg yolk 1/2 pint heavy cream 1 1/2 ounces evaporated milk 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon maple syrup 1/2 cup mini chocolate chips 2 ripe, mashed bananas 1 cup dark chocolate 2 tablespoons coconut oil
directions: Heat half and half, sugar and salt in a saucepan over medium heat. Once warm and sugar is dissolved, temper in your egg yolks. While constantly stirring, cook the egg and milk mixture low and slow until it thickens just enough to coat the back of your wooden spoon. Strain mixture into a bowl over an ice bath and stir until cool. Stir in your heavy cream, evaporated milk, vanilla and maple syrup. Add your mashed bananas and churn in your ice cream machine. Once you see your ice cream start to thicken up, add in your mini chocolate chips. Pour into your mold and freeze over night! In the morning, melt dark chocolate and coconut oil and cool at room temperature. Remove pops from the mold and dunk half way into the chocolate dip and watch the magic happen! Add any special add ons you'd like (walnuts, sprinkles, even more chocolate chips!) to the chocolate as soon as you dip. Freeze until ready to enjoy!

title: Italian Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, chopped 1 green pepper, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 (15 ounce) cans tomato sauce 1 (14 1/2 ounce) can diced tomatoes 1 12 tablespoons oregano 12 ounces cream cheese 12 -14 ounces sour cream 8 ounces cottage cheese parmesan cheese 16 ounces wide egg noodles salt and pepper
directions: Brown ground beef and saute onion, green pepper, and garlic. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, and oregano. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. While sauce is simmering, blend cream cheese, sour cream, and cottage cheese with a hand mixer or blender. Boil the 16oz package of extra wide egg noodles al dente. Spread a small amount of sauce on the bottom of a 13x9 inch baking dish. Put half of the noodles in the pan then spread the cream cheese mixture over the noodles. Pour over the rest of the noodles then spread the sauce on top. Sprinkle generously with Parmesan. Bake for approximately 45 minutes at 350 degrees. You'll know it's done when it bubbles around the edges.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cut in small pieces 1 cup sour cream 2 (10 1/2 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup 1 (4 ounce) can diced green chilies 1 onion, chopped 1 teaspoon chili powder salt pepper 8 inches flour tortillas 2 teaspoons butter 1 (16 ounce) bag mixed cheeses
directions: Mix together in bowl sour cream and cream of chicken soup. Set aside. Cook Chicken breast pieces in butter with chopped onion. When tender add chili powder and green chilis. (you can alternate green chili with drained rotell for spicer flavor) Add about 2 tablespoons of sour cream and chicken soup mixture to chicken. You may want to add salt, pepper, or even some garlic if you choose. Roll up chicken in each flour tortilla. Do not layer. After filling each tortilla cover them with the remaining sour cream and soup mixture. Cover with cheese. Place in 350 degree oven for about 25 minutes.

title: Eggnog Ladyfinger Dessert
ingredients: 2 packages (3 ounces each) ladyfingers, split 1 pint raspberry or cranberry sorbet 3 cups eggnog 1 cup evaporated milk 1/2 cup sour cream 2 packages (3.4 ounces each) instant vanilla pudding mix Fresh raspberries or cranberries and fresh mint leaves
directions: Arrange 24 ladyfingers around the edge of an ungreased 9-in. springform pan; arrange 16 ladyfingers over the bottom (save remaining ladyfingers for another use). Spoon sorbet over ladyfingers; cover and freeze for 30 minutes. In a large bowl, beat the eggnog, evaporated milk, sour cream and pudding mix until thickened, about 2 minutes. Spoon over sorbet. Cover and freeze for 8 hours or overnight. Remove from the freezer 5-10 minutes before slicing. Garnish with raspberries and mint.

title: Jennie's Favorite Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon rosemary (optional) 0.5 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix 1 (10 3/4 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup 1 (10 3/4 ounce) can cream of celery soup 2 teaspoons beef bouillon 1 cup hot water 8 ounces sliced mushrooms (optional) 6 medium pork chops (or 1 pork loin) 14 cup flour 14 cup oil
directions: In a large bowl, mix black pepper, garlic powder, rosemary, dry onion soup mix, cream of mushroom soup, cream of celery soup, beef bouillon and hot water. Set aside. In a large frying pan (with deep sides), heat your oil. Coat your pork chops in flour and add to pan. Cook until lightly browned and turn over. Remove pork chops from the pan and pour in your soup mixture. Whisk to get all the good bits off the frying pan. Add your pork chops back to the pan. Simmer on low for 30 minutes (or until your pork chops are cooked through). CROCK POT VERSION: Do all steps up to frying up your chops and adding the soup mixture. Place pork on bottom of crock pot, cover with soup mixture and cook on low for approximately 6 hours. Add mushrooms the last 30 minutes if desired. OVEN VERSION: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Do all steps up to frying and adding soup mixture. Place pork on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Cover with soup mixture and bake for approximately 30 minutes or until done. Serve with mashed potatoes and a veggie -- the sauce makes a fantastic gravy for potatoes! Hope you enjoy!

title: Ginger Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 1 16-ounce Bag Frozen Carrots 3 Tablespoons Butter, Melted 2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar 1 Tablespoon Dijon Mustard 1/4 Teaspoon Ground Ginger
directions: Cook carrots according to package directions; drain and place in serving bowl. Set aside. In a small bowl, whisk together melted butter, brown sugar, Dijon mustard and ginger. Pour butter sauce over hot carrots and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Makes 4-6 servings. *Brown sugar substitute (Splenda) may be used instead of regular brown sugar.

title: Moist Sweet Potato Cookies
ingredients: 200 grams Sweet potato 10 grams Sugar 50 ml Milk 80 grams Unsalted butter (margarine) 50 grams Sugar 200 grams Sweet potato paste 110 grams Cake flour 40 grams Almond flour
directions: Make the sweet potato paste. Peel the sweet potatoes and soak in water for 10 minutes to get rid of any bitterness. Boil the sweet potatoes in just enough water to cover. They are done once they change color and brighten up, and a bamboo skewer goes through a piece easily. While they are still warm, put the sweet potatoes in a food processor with the sugar and milk, and process until smooth. Make the dough. Preheat the oven to 190 C. Mix the butter, which should be at room temperature, and the sugar together very well. Measure out 200 g of the sweet potato paste you made in step 3 and add to the butter-sugar mix. Mix until smooth. Sift in the cake and almond flours and fold them in. Use your hands to form balls with the dough. Lightly flatten each ball, and line them up on your baking pan (You can form the dough in any shape you like.) Bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes. Once the bottom has turned golden brown, they are done! They're also delicious warmed up in a toaster oven just before eating.

title: Aubergine With Pine Nuts Imperial Herbal Restaurant Recipe
ingredients: 2/3 c. Plus 2 tsp. cornstarch 1/4 c. All-purpose flour 1 lb Aubergine, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes 5 c. Plus 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil 1/2 c. Pine nuts 1 tsp Light soy sauce 1 tsp Dark soy sauce 4 tsp Sugar 1 1/2 Tbsp. Chopped peeled fresh ginger root 1 1/2 Tbsp. Finely minced scallion 2 tsp Chopped garlic 1 tsp Asian chili sauce 2 tsp Asian (toasted) sesame oil
directions: In a paper bag or possibly resealable plastic bag combine 2/3 c. of the cornstarch and the flour and shake the mix well. In a colander rinse the aubergine, drain it, and in batches shake it in the cornstarch mix, transferring each batch as it is coated to a large bowl. In a wok heat 1 c. of the vegetable oil over high heat till it is warm but not smoking, in it fry the pine nuts till they are golden brown, and transfer them with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain. To the vegetable oil in the wok, add in 4 c. of the remaining vegetable oil, heat the oil over high heat till it registers 375 degrees F on a deep-fat thermometer, and in it fry the aubergine in 3 batches, stirring and turning the aubergine occasionally, for 6 min, or possibly till it is golden. Tablespoons ransfer the aubergine as it is fried with a slotted spoon to a large sieve or possibly colander set over a bowl, let it drain for 5 min, and transfer it to a serving bowl. In a small bowl stir together the soy sauces, sugar, remaining 2 tsp. cornstarch, and broth, stirring till cornstarch is dissolved. Throw away the oil in the wok and wipe the wok clean with paper towels. In the wok heat the remaining 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil over high heat till it is warm but not smoking and in it stir-fry the gingerroot, scallion, garlic, and the chili sauce for 30 seconds , or possibly till the mix is fragrant. Stir the soy sauce mix, add in it to the scallion mix, and bring the sauce to a boil, stirring. Stir in the sesame oil and the pine nuts and pour the sauce ov er the aubergine. Yield: 4 serving

title: Cheese Potato Pancakes
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, unpeeled and boiled for 10 minutes 1/4 cup sweet onion, sliced thinly 1/4 cup red pepper, diced 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 egg, lightly beaten 2 tablespoons heavy cream 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese 1/2 cup grated mozzarella cheese, cheeses 1 tablespoon butter 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
directions: Grate potatoes in food processor. Heat butter and oil in skillet over medium heat. Mix potatoes with rest of ingredients. Form into patties and cook for about 4 minutes on each side. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Papa Stew
ingredients: 2 cans Veg-All 2 cans tomatoes 1 can French-cut beans 1 can corn (whole kernel) 2 beef bouillon cubes 1 lb. hamburger meat
directions: Simmer all vegetables together in large boiler. Simmer for about 45 minutes. Cook meat and drain well. Add to vegetables and continue to simmer for about 20 more minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. corn syrup 1 c. roasted Macadamia nuts, chopped 1 Tbsp. butter 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. baking soda
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, and nuts in a microwave safe container. Microwave, covered on HIGH for 3 minutes. Add butter and vanilla and microwave on HIGH for 1 minute. Add baking soda and stir until foamy and smooth. Pour into a large greased tupperware container and cool for 1 hour. When hardened, remove from tupperware, crack, and serve.

title: That Good- Tasting Chicken Dish
ingredients: 14 cup crisco vegetable oil, divided 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces 1 (2 7/8 ounce) can French-fried onions, crushed 12 cup grated parmesan cheese 12 cup fine dry breadcrumb 12 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon garlic powder 1 large egg, beaten 1 tablespoon milk
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Spread 1 Tbls oil over bottom of a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Rinse chicken -- pat dry. I have used some chicken breasts and thighs for the whole chicken. Combine onions, cheese, bread crumbs (or panko crumbs), salt and some garlic powder in a bowl. Combine egg and milk in separate bowl. Dip chicken in egg and then in crumb mixture to coat,. Place chicken in the prepared pan. Drizzle with remaining oil. Bake 1 hour or until juices run clear. I have sprayed the chicken with Pam instead of using the oil and it works ok.

title: Chicken Kebabs And Nectarine Salsa
ingredients: 1 tablespoon brown sugar 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice 2 teaspoons chili powder 1 teaspoon bottled minced garlic 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 24 (2-inch) pieces 1 large red onion, cut into 32 (2-inch) pieces Cooking spray 2 cups diced nectarine (about 3) 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper 1/4 cup thinly sliced red onion 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lime juice 2 teaspoons minced seeded jalapeno pepper 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 cup diced peeled avocado
directions: Preheat broiler. Combine first 9 ingredients in a shallow dish; let stand 15 minutes. Thread 4 onion pieces and 3 chicken pieces alternately onto each of 8 (12-inch) skewers. Place skewers on broiler pan coated with cooking spray. Broil 12 minutes or until chicken is done, turning occasionally. Combine nectarines and next 6 ingredients (through 1/4 teaspoon salt) in a bowl. Gently stir in avocado.

title: Lime Congealed Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. lime jello (3 oz. size) 1 medium can crushed pineapple (do not drain) 1 carton small cottage cheese 1/2 c. slivered almonds 1/2 pt. whipped cream
directions: Heat pineapple. Place dry jello in warm pineapple with 1 envelope of gelatin (wet). Cool. Mix cottage cheese, almonds and whipped cream. Chill. Serve with mayonnaise and cherry on top.

title: Brown Sugar Bread Pudding With Crème Anglaise
ingredients: 4 egg whites 1 large egg 1 1/4 cups 2% reduced-fat milk 3/4 cup evaporated fat-free milk 1/2 cup firmly packed light brown sugar 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/8 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 (12-ounce) French bread loaf, cut into 1-inch cubes (about 8 cups) Vegetable cooking spray 4 teaspoons light brown sugar 1/2 tablespoon butter, cut into small pieces 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted Garnish: cinnamon sticks
directions: Whisk together egg whites and egg in a medium bowl until blended. Whisk in reduced-fat milk and next 7 ingredients. Arrange bread cubes in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread. Sprinkle evenly with 4 teaspoons brown sugar, butter, and almonds. Press down gently on bread cubes, and let stand 10 minutes. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm with 2 tablespoons chilled Creme Anglaise per serving. Garnish, if desired.

title: Oxtail Casserole
ingredients: 2 kg oxtails, cut into pieces 2 onions, peeled and chopped 4 carrots, peeled and roughly chopped 2 small turnips, peeled and chopped 2 tablespoons oil 2 garlic cloves, peeled and chopped 2 tablespoons plain flour 150 ml red wine 600 ml beef stock 1 tablespoon tomato puree 1 bay leaf
directions: Set the oven to hot 220c/475f. Pack the piece of oxtail, onion, carrot and turnip in a roasting tin and sprinkle with oil. Roast for 30-40 mins until browned, stirring once during cooking. Remove tin from oven, then turn the oven temperature down to cool at 150c/300f. Spoon a couple of tablespoons of fat from the tin into a large flameproof casserole. Add the garlic and fry for 1minute, then stir in the flour and mix well. Pour in the wine and stock, add the puree and bay leaf, season well. Bring to the boil. Add oxtail and vegetables, cover with lid and or foil. Cook for 3 hours or until meat pulls away from the bone. Skim off fat from surface if you prefer. Serve with lots of mashed potato and cabbage.

title: Wild Rice Chicken Dinner
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice mix (6 oz.), cooked 1 can cream of chicken soup 3 c. cooked chicken 1 c. chicken broth 1 c. chopped celery 1/4 c. chopped onions 1 (6 to 8 oz.) can water chestnuts, sliced and drained 1 (3 oz.) can chopped mushrooms, drained 3 Tbsp. soy sauce 1 1/2 c. buttered bread crumbs (for topping)
directions: Mix all ingredients, except bread crumbs. Put in casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 8 servings.

title: Pon de Rings that You Can Easily Roll Up By Hand
ingredients: 200 grams Bread (strong) flour 80 grams Shiratamako (mochiko) 10 grams Sugar 5 grams Salt 10 grams Skim milk powder 70 grams Silken tofu 15 grams Butter (or margarine) 150 ml Water 1 tsp Dried yeast
directions: Make the dough. Place everything into the bread maker bowl, knead for about 15 minutes, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit for 30 minutes. Then start bread maker pizza course! Divide the completed dough into about 40g portions roll it up, cover with a cloth, and let sit for 15 minutes. Divide into six balls. If you pinch just a small amount of the balls together, then they won't break apart so easily when fried. Lightly coat the joints with water, reinforcing them. It takes time to roll these up, so in order to keep the dough from drying out after rolling them up, cover with a cloth, or use the fermentation function on your oven. Fry at 160C until they are nice colored. Use whatever toppings you like! You can also divide it into 6 balls and just fry it like that! This is what it looks like when you fry it at half portions of the 6 pieces. I stuck the centers together thoroughly so that they won't fall apart.

title: Pork Loin(Yield: 12 Servings)
ingredients: 1/4 c. olive oil 2 Tbsp. ground coriander 2 Tbsp. coarse salt 1 Tbsp. black pepper 2 tsp. crushed red pepper 1 tsp. ground cumin 1 (8 lb.) Bone-in Pork Loin Roast
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix first 6 ingredients in small bowl to blend. Place pork on rack in large roasting pan. Rub spice mixture all over. Roast until meat thermometer inserted into center registers 150°, about 2 hours 30 minutes. Transfer roast to platter. Tent with foil; let stand 10 minutes. Carve roast. Good to serve with Cranberry and Coriander Chutney Sauce.

title: Chess Bars
ingredients: 1 egg 1 stick butter 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding 3 eggs 8 oz. cream cheese 1 box powdered sugar
directions: Mix egg, butter and cake mix; this will be very stiff so you will need to pat into pan. Beat eggs and cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth; pour on top of first mixture in pan. Bake at 300° for 60 minutes. Let cool and cut into squares.

title: Quick And Easy Party Meat Balls
ingredients: 3 to 5 lb. ground beef 1 to 2 packets Lipton onion soup mix 2 to 3 jars Heinz chili sauce 10 to 12 oz. jar Welch's grape jelly 1 to 2 eggs
directions: Mix ground beef, eggs and soup mix real good. Roll into 1-inch balls. Cook at 350° until brown. While meat balls are cooking, in a large saucepan, mix chili sauce and jelly, heating to boiling. When meat balls are cooked, add them to the sauce. Cover and simmer on warm heat until ready to serve. The meat balls can be made ahead of time and placed in the freezer until you want to have a party.

title: Frozen Macarons
ingredients: 1 Pastel colored dragees (pale blue and silver) 2 Egg whites 1 Granulated sugar; 75% of the weight of the egg whites) 1 Almond flour; the same weight as the egg whites 1 few drops Vanilla extract 80 grams Butter 1 Egg white 10 grams Granulated sugar 25 grams Powdered sugar 1 few drops Vanilla extract 1/3 tsp Flavoring liqueur of your choice 1 dash Food coloring, optional
directions: Weigh the egg whites. The weight of the other macaron ingredients will be calculated based on that. Measure carefully. Beat the egg whites with a handheld mixer to turn it into meringue. Add the granulated sugar to it in 2 batches as you whip it. Sift the almond flour and powdered sugar together twice. Add the meringue to this in 3 batches, folding it in. Use a cut and fold motion, stirring up from the bottom. Don't crush the air bubbles or beat the mixture too much. It's similar to when you stir up freshly cooked rice. When everything is mixed, add the vanilla essence. Then perform the macaronage (a procedure used to make macarons): Lift the mixture up from the bottom of the bowl with your spatula, and then stroke the surface. Repeat several times. When the batter forms a thick ribbon that falls slowly from the spatula, it's done. It can be a bit puffy still. Make a piping bag ready by folding back the edge and standing it up in a cup. Transfer the macaron batter to the piping bag. Pipe the batter out onto a kitchen parchment paper lined baking sheet. Aim to make each round 3 cm in diameter. Gently put the dragees on top of the macarons, then push them in very lightly with the blunt end of a toothpick. Leave the macarons until the surface has dried completely. This will take 1 to 5 hours, depending on the humidity. Bake in a 180C oven for 3 to 5 minutes. The pieds (the 'feet' of a macaron, or the frilly parts around the perimeter) will start to form.
